note: Registry data could not be retrieved. The DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection errors ('Connection refused') on both queries, and Bing/Google returned only irrelevant results for the exact-name queries. Direct fetches of public company-data profiles (ZaubaCorp, TheCompanyCheck, Tofler, FalconEBiz) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; QuickCompany and InstaFinancials returned 404 for the guessed URL slugs; the MCA portal host did not resolve. Therefore CIN/LLPIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state, MCA status and audited revenue for FY25/FY26 are all null — none of these are public to me at this time and none have been inferred or invented. No rejection is applied: there is no evidence the entity does not exist, is struck off, liquidated or bankrupt — the absence of data is a research limitation, not a negative finding. Role is recorded as 'unknown' because the manufacturer/trader distinction cannot be established from registry records alone. Note also that the declared HS codes (390110 polyethylene, 760720 aluminium foil) span two unrelated chapters, which is a classification question for the HS reviewer, not a registry matter. Recommended next step: manual lookup of the exact name on the MCA portal (mca.gov.in / search.mca.gov.in) and on the GST portal's 'Search Taxpayer' by trade name, then re-run this record.
